places.title: Lt Gen Sagat Singh Memorial, Bikaner
places.description: A memorial planned in Bikaner, centred on his bronze bust before a wall of relief panels from his campaigns.
places.homeBlurb: A memorial planned in Bikaner, centred on his bronze bust before a wall of relief panels from his campaigns.
places.imagesNote: From the memorial plan. They show what the memorial could look like, and the likeness of the General in the bust is an artist's impression.

images.caption: The memorial: bust and plinth before the battle heritage wall
Master plan, 40 x 80 ft: entrance gate, flag plaza, leadership walkway, statue plaza
Bust detail: 42 in bronze bust on a 6 ft plinth, about 9.5 ft overall
Battle heritage wall panels: early years, Goa 1961, Nathu La and Cho La 1967, Meghna 1971, legacy

places.title: Lt Gen Sagat Singh Museum, Gun House, Bikaner
places.description: The Gun House in Bikaner was the residence the Maharaja of Bikaner gave him after his marriage. A plan has been prepared to turn it into a museum of his life, room by room.
